cues: The general way to make an ether is Williamson's synthesis.
Warm a sodium alkoxide with a haloalkane, in dry conditions.
Sodium ethoxide and iodoethane give diethyl ether and sodium iodide.
Sodium phenoxide and iodomethane give anisole.
text: The general way to make an ether is Williamson's synthesis. Warm a sodium alkoxide with a haloalkane, in dry conditions. Sodium ethoxide and iodoethane give diethyl ether and sodium iodide. Sodium phenoxide and iodomethane give anisole.
